Exhaustion of all four-vertex sets gives exactly \(35\) nonzero minimum-support classes; cocycle values give \(34\) primitive and one double class, and group exhaustion gives the stated orbit sizes. value.rationale: The four-vertex supports are the exact integral homology systoles by vertex support, a natural invariant of a small triangulation. The source singles out the diagonal \(S^2\) geometrically; the new classification shows that this distinguished sphere is also the unique nonprimitive shortest homology carrier, while all other shortest carriers are primitive. The full \(A_4\)-orbit decomposition makes the distinction structural rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
